name: onboarding_apply_privileges
description: Install the literal, per-host sudoers grant that lets onboarding apply selected elevated host requirements without a second prompt.

sudoers.rationale: The grant is setup-managed host policy and contains only exact selected control-plane argv.

storage.rationale: The grant is host policy, never scenario data.

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.evidence: Windows does not expose the Linux host interface used by safeguard onboarding_apply_privileges; the platform has a distinct host security and lifecycle model.
